title: Editor content and upload trust
focus: Finish exact saved/pasted content/image/upload safety/lifetime successors. Existing link/image policies and stale upload matrices are accepted; target remaining source/render paths and produce concrete safe patches.

originalChecklistStatements.A-E-06: - [ ] A-E-06 Reconcile original `E-06`: Define safe URL/protocol handling, image metadata/alt text, host upload callbacks, file validation, cancellation, and object-URL cleanup. Shared saved/pasted link policy and activation: [partial contract](react-aria-editor-section.md#link-destination-policy-e-06e-07-partial). Saved image sources and upload-result retry: [partial image contract](react-aria-editor-section.md#image-source-policy-e-06e-07-partial); [upload lifetime matrix](react-aria-editor-section.md#host-upload-lifetime-e-06-partial) covers stale results after cancellation/reset/read-only/unmount; [file presentation validation](react-aria-editor-dialogs.md#file-presentation-validation-e-06-partial) covers empty files and MIME/extension metadata; wider image/upload acceptance remains open. Historical status: open.
originalChecklistStatements.A-E-07: - [ ] A-E-07 Reconcile original `E-07`: Review rich-content rendering and trust boundaries; do not render arbitrary HTML or unsafe links merely because they arrived in a presentation model. Saved/pasted link destinations are governed by the [owned policy](react-aria-editor-section.md#link-destination-policy-e-06e-07-partial), and image decoration by the [image source policy](react-aria-editor-section.md#image-source-policy-e-06e-07-partial); broader rich-content acceptance remains open. Historical status: open.

successors.deliverable: Document and obtain owner acceptance for host upload byte/type/size/dimension/asset authorization, network abort semantics and cleanup of host-created stale assets. Preserve File callback and UI-only cancellation ownership.
successors.acceptanceEvidenceRequired: Host adapter/service policy with tested rejection/cleanup outcomes; no credentials or real service changes are authorized by this report.

successors.deliverable: Reconcile remaining upload/URL paths using trust matrix: malformed encoded sources/redirect ownership, description/metadata fidelity, retry and late result after each termination. Add only gaps beyond retained lifecycle cases.
successors.acceptanceEvidenceRequired: Named source/host/promise ownership, exact output/error/insert count and released URL owner per missing case; physical-device/AT evidence remains distinct.

A-E-06.limits: Accept only the original bounded criterion and explicit input/host/engine limits in the report. No inferred production/device/AT/legal approval.

Historical status: open.

successors.deliverable: Approve a rich-document trust policy for imported/pasted author CSS, malformed/unregistered node/version data, data/blob/remote image requests and downstream JSON renderers; convert the trust matrix into bounded rejection/fidelity fixtures.
successors.acceptanceEvidenceRequired: Owner decision states allowed/rejected/preserved fields and host CSP/authorization/redirect responsibilities. Browser evidence demonstrates inert hostile markup/styles/URLs per approved policy without corrupting saved metadata; do not silently broaden current URL policy.

A-E-07.limits: Accept only the original bounded criterion and explicit input/host/engine limits in the report. No inferred production/device/AT/legal approval.
